description: Frontend refinement + compliance scrub: 9-agent AGENT_STEPS reconciliation driven by backend logs (Judge included, Medical->Clinical Consistency), the Master Claim Form view with source->extracted->master drill-down, decision UI with explanation, improved ProcessingLogs, SYNTHETIC DEMO labeling, the repo-wide compliance-claim scrub, and the extended/new Vitest tests. Design §13, §13.4. Depends on FEAT-004 (consumes the canonical /process shape). Independent of FEAT-005.
steps: Edit frontend/src/hooks/useClaimAgent.js: replace the 8-entry AGENT_STEPS with the 9 executing agents in pipeline order using display names matching backend AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES: scanner 'Scanner Agent', ocr 'OCR Agent', validator 'Validator Agent', clinical 'Clinical Consistency Agent' (was medical/'Medical Expert'), policy 'Policy Agent', fraud 'Fraud Detection Agent', risk 'Risk Assessment Agent', judge 'Judge Agent' (NEW), comm 'Communication Agent'. Drive step state from the returned data.logs (mark completed/error only for agents present; grey out non-executed), replacing the real-mode stepAnimator timer. Extend getDemoAgentLogs/getDemoPayload to 9 entries and label demo payloads/badges 'SYNTHETIC DEMO'. Pass canonical fields (masterClaimForm, decision, riskBreakdown) through results.

Create frontend/src/components/claimbitz/MasterClaimForm.jsx + SectionCard.jsx + ProvenanceBadge.jsx rendering all 12 sections. Each scalar shows value + a status badge (Extracted/Missing/Conflict/Verified/Low Confidence) + source_document + page; conflicts expand to show every conflicts[] value with its source. Missing and conflicting fields are shown, never hidden. List sections (procedures/investigations/medications/billing) render as tables with per-cell badges; billing shows calculated_total, submitted_total, billing_difference, flag.

Add the Source Document -> Extracted Data -> Master Claim Form drill-down: reuse DashboardDocumentViewer for the source view, add an 'Extracted' intermediate panel (raw OCR values with page refs) linking into the Master Claim Form section; clicking a field jumps to its source page.

Update frontend/src/components/claimbitz/{RiskPanel,ResolutionLayer}.jsx to render the decision block: the risk % with an explanation that it is overall_review_risk.score (display-only, not the decision gate) and the decision basis = basis evidence list + blockingConditions; render the six risk dimensions as a small bar list from riskBreakdown.

Upgrade frontend/src/components/claimbitz/ProcessingLogs.jsx to show per structured log row: timestamp, agent (display name), action, input/output summary, status, duration, confidence, error, requestId — wired to data.logs; keep the collapsible terminal styling. Update GeneratedOutput.jsx and AgentTimeline.jsx + Dashboard.jsx to the 9-agent timeline and canonical blocks; add a SYNTHETIC DEMO banner in the Master Claim Form view when demoMode.

Compliance scrub: grep frontend/src/**, README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md for 'HIPAA compliant'/'DPDP compliant'/'IRDAI certified' (and close variants) and replace any with 'Designed with security and auditability controls.' These exact tokens are not present today, so this step may be a no-op edit-wise — it must NOT introduce them and the string-scan test below guards against regressions.

Extend frontend/src/hooks/__tests__/useClaimAgent.test.js: AGENT_STEPS has 9 entries including judge and clinical (the current assertions expecting 8 / 'OCR Agent' at index 1 / 'Communication' at index 7 must be updated to the new roster). Add: a run marks only agents present in data.logs as completed; a string-scan test asserting no 'HIPAA/DPDP/IRDAI' strings remain; 'SYNTHETIC DEMO' label present in demo mode. Add a component test rendering MISSING/CONFLICT badges from a canonical masterClaimForm fixture.
acceptance_criteria: AGENT_STEPS has exactly 9 entries including a 'judge' step and a 'clinical' step named 'Clinical Consistency Agent'; the updated hook test passes.

`npm run test` (cwd frontend) passes, including the 9-step roster assertions, the logs-driven completion test, the no-'HIPAA/DPDP/IRDAI' string-scan test, the SYNTHETIC DEMO label test, and the MISSING/CONFLICT badge render test.
The Master Claim Form view renders MISSING and CONFLICT fields (not hidden) with status badges and source/page.
No 'HIPAA/DPDP/IRDAI' compliance-claim strings exist in frontend/src/**, README.md, or ARCHITECTURE.md.
verification: cmd: npm run build (cwd frontend) — build succeeds.
cmd: npm run test (cwd frontend) — all frontend tests pass.
findings:
LANDED. `npm install` + `npm run build` succeed; `npm run test -- run` passes 16/16 (vitest 1.6.1, single file src/hooks/__tests__/useClaimAgent.test.js). All FEAT-006 acceptance criteria met.

=== useClaimAgent.js ===
AGENT_STEPS rewritten to the 9 executing agents in pipeline order, each { id, role, name, description, icon }: scanner/'Scanner Agent', ocr/'OCR Agent', validator/'Validator Agent', clinical/'Clinical Consistency Agent' (was medical/'Medical Expert'), policy/'Policy Agent', fraud/'Fraud Detection Agent', risk/'Risk Assessment Agent', judge/'Judge Agent' (NEW), comm/'Communication Agent'. The display `name`s follow design §13.1 / the task roster (NOT the raw backend AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES values, which differ e.g. 'Document Scanner Agent'/'OCR\/Extraction Agent'/'Policy Expert Agent'). The new `role` field holds the STABLE backend agent_role used to reconcile step state.

NEW export `agentsFromLogs(logs)`: maps backend `data.logs` rows to per-agent status by matching r.agent_role===step.role (fallback r.agent===step.name). status 'error' -> 'error', any other matching row -> 'completed', no matching row -> 'idle' (greyed out, never fabricated). In real mode processReal() now calls agentsFromLogs(data.logs) and setAgents(reconciled) INSTEAD of the old setInterval stepAnimator timer (timer removed). Demo mode still steps sequentially through 9 agents then marks the synthetic roster complete.

NEW export `SYNTHETIC_DEMO_LABEL` = 'SYNTHETIC DEMO'. getDemoPayload() now tags base with synthetic/demoLabel = SYNTHETIC_DEMO_LABEL. getDemoAgentLogs() extended low/medium/high arrays to 9 entries each (judge row inserted before comm; clinical activity text).

=== NEW components (frontend/src/components/claimbitz/) ===
ProvenanceBadge.jsx: status chip (EXTRACTED/VERIFIED green, MISSING grey, CONFLICT red, LOW_CONFIDENCE amber); renders data-status attr (used by the badge render test). Exports STATUS_META.
SectionCard.jsx: renders a section's scalar FieldProvenance rows (value + ProvenanceBadge + confidence% + source_document/page line); CONFLICT fields expand every conflicts[] value with its own source; accepts onFieldClick(prov) (jump-to-source when prov.page!=null). Also used as a shell (children) by list/billing/supporting sections.
MasterClaimForm.jsx: renders all 12 sections + jurisdiction. Scalar sections: claim_info/patient/policy/provider/hospitalization/clinical via SectionCard. List sections procedures/investigations/medications as tables with per-cell badges + list_status badge. Billing table + calculated_total/submitted_total/billing_difference/currency/flag (flag green when BILLING_TOTAL_CONSISTENT). supporting_documents present/not-included + badge. SYNTHETIC DEMO banner (data-testid='synthetic-demo-banner') when demoMode. MISSING/CONFLICT shown, never hidden.

=== Updated components ===
RiskPanel.jsx: new optional props decision + riskBreakdown. Adds a decision-explanation block: the review % is labeled display-only = overall_review_risk.score (NOT the gate), the six risk dimensions render as a bar list (documentation/policy/clinical/billing/fraud/overall_review, with blocking tag), a Decision basis list from decision.basis [{source,evidence}], and a Blocking conditions chip list from decision.blockingConditions. Backward compatible (all new props default null).
ResolutionLayer.jsx: new optional `decision` prop; surfaces decision.blockingConditions as a chip row.
ProcessingLogs.jsx: new optional `structuredLogs` prop (= data.logs). When present renders a StructuredRows block above the terminal stream showing agent (display name), action, status, duration_ms, confidence, request_id, input->output summary, and error; keeps the collapsible terminal styling and the legacy free-text terminalLogs stream.
GeneratedOutput.jsx: Summary tab now also shows decision.rationale when present.
Dashboard.jsx: AGENT_REGIONS medical->clinical and judge added. Passes decision+riskBreakdown to RiskPanel, decision to ResolutionLayer, structuredLogs={results.logs} to ProcessingLogs. Renders the MasterClaimForm view (demoMode banner) when results.masterClaimForm present. Header shows a 'Synthetic Demo' chip when demoMode. Timeline/9-agent roster flows automatically from the hook's agents array.

=== Compliance scrub (design §13.4) ===
NO-OP as predicted: no 'HIPAA compliant'/'DPDP compliant'/'IRDAI certified' (or close variants) exist in frontend/src/**, README.md, or ARCHITECTURE.md. Nothing introduced. The only HIPAA/DPDP/IRDAI occurrences in the repo are inside the new string-scan test (its describe/it names and the guard regex), which is intentional.

=== Tests (frontend/src/hooks/__tests__/useClaimAgent.test.js, rewritten) ===
16 tests: 9-step roster (len 9, Scanner/OCR/Validator at 0/1/2, Communication at 8, judge+clinical present, old 'medical' id gone, each has id/role/name/description/icon); logs-driven reconciliation (only agents in logs completed, error status propagates, empty logs -> all idle); SYNTHETIC_DEMO_LABEL export + banner present in demoMode / absent otherwise; string-scan asserting no HIPAA/DPDP/IRDAI claim strings in frontend/src (walks the tree, excludes nothing by name but matches only the claim phrases); MasterClaimForm renders MISSING+CONFLICT+EXTRACTED badges and expands conflicting values with sources; return-value/reset/terminal-logging smoke checks. NOTE: the test file is .js but renders components via React.createElement (NOT JSX) because vitest's rollup SSR parse does not apply the react JSX transform to .js files; the filename was kept as required.

FILES CHANGED (committed on feat/master-claim-form, NOT pushed): frontend/src/hooks/useClaimAgent.js, frontend/src/hooks/__tests__/useClaimAgent.test.js, frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx, frontend/src/components/claimbitz/{RiskPanel,ResolutionLayer,ProcessingLogs,GeneratedOutput}.jsx, and NEW frontend/src/components/claimbitz/{MasterClaimForm,SectionCard,ProvenanceBadge}.jsx.
